text: I think you'll really enjoy this Make-Ahead Hawaiian Chicken Packets recipe, especially given your preference for pasta and potatoes. While it may not be a traditional pasta or potato dish, the flavors and ingredients are quite similar to what you might find in a Hawaiian-style pasta salad or a potato-based dish. The teriyaki sauce and pineapple tidbits add a sweet and savory element that's likely to appeal to you. Plus, at only 289 calories per serving, this recipe fits within your goal of consuming fewer calories.
